translations.web: Among the builders, everyone wore his sword at his side, and so built. He who sounded the trumpet was by me.
translations.bsb: And each of the builders worked with his sword strapped at his side. But the trumpeter stayed beside me.
translations.kjv: For the builders, every one had his sword girded by his side, and so builded. And he that sounded the trumpet was by me.
translations.asv: and the builders, every one had his sword girded by his side, and so builded. And he that sounded the trumpet was by me.
